title: Pulmonary fibrosis, scleroderma lung, tracheostomy and ventilator
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's lung fibrosis or airway status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

HPI
Pt is a 56-year-old female presenting for scheduled f/u of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. She reports she has been feeling stable and denies any acute shortness of breath or increased cough since the last visit. She is adherent to her current antifibrotic medication. She reports no new side effects.

Medication List
Nintedanib 150mg BID.

Exam
Pt in no acute distress. CTAB. RRR. Lungs: diminished breath sounds at bases, no adventitious sounds. Heart: regular rhythm, no murmurs. Extremities: no edema.

Assessment
1. Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: Stable. Recent PFTs show stable lung function tests. Pt tolerating antifibrotic therapy well.

Plan
1. Continue current antifibrotic medication.
2. Continue monitoring of lung function.
3. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
10/14/2026
